sentences.zh: 我们回到了那个状态，做饭的意义是为了生存，为了填饱肚子。

sentences.en: And that really changes kind of the way you're even thinking about cooking instead of making a really fancy meal.
sentences.zh: 这真的改变了你对做饭的看法，不再是为了做一顿丰盛的大餐。

sentences.en: You're just kind of like, what's in the cupboard?
sentences.zh: 你只是在想，橱柜里有什么？

sentences.en: What can I make?
sentences.zh: 我能做什么？

sentences.en: How many cans of syrup, of soup are you using?
sentences.zh: 你用了几罐糖浆，几罐汤？

sentences.en: Four.
sentences.zh: 四罐。

sentences.en: Oh, then put them in.
sentences.zh: 哦，那就放进去吧。

sentences.en: Got it.
sentences.zh: 明白了。

sentences.en: As long as you've got them, you put them in.
sentences.zh: 只要你有，就放进去。

sentences.en: And the nice thing is all of her recipes are really easy ingredients to find during quarantine.
sentences.zh: 好的一点是，她所有的食谱在隔离期间都很容易找到食材。

sentences.en: You know, it's like all like cans and beans and condiments.
sentences.zh: 你知道，就像是罐头、豆子和调味品之类的。

sentences.en: I think as a result of this, some people will be cooks and some people will never look at cooking again.
sentences.zh: 我想结果就是，有些人会变成厨师，而有些人再也不想碰做饭了。

sentences.en: I think, I think you're absolutely right.
sentences.zh: 我想，我想你说得完全对。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Cut the onion in quarters and stick it in the soup.
sentences.zh: 把洋葱切成四块，放进汤里。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Uh-oh.
sentences.zh: 哎呀。

sentences.en: Should I have peeled it first?
sentences.zh: 我是不是应该先剥皮？

sentences.en: Oh, yes.
sentences.zh: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: Well, I think, I think if you're not a real cook and everything, it can be very therapeutic.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我觉得如果你不是真正的厨师，做这些事会非常有疗愈感。

sentences.en: Especially now, if you can focus on anything, be it cooking or anything, it's very helpful.
sentences.zh: 尤其是现在，如果你能专注于某件事，无论是做饭还是别的，都很有帮助。

sentences.en: This is, this is my kind of cooking.
sentences.zh: 这就是，这就是我喜欢的做饭方式。

sentences.en: My kind of cooking is like, you know, kind of like assembly more than cooking.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢的做饭方式更像是组装，而不是烹饪。

sentences.en: Well, um, during the depression, my mother- I thought we were just going to be cooking, which is what we did, but it was like so many stories.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大萧条时期，我母亲——我以为我们只是要煮饭，我们确实也做了，但那里面有太多的故事了。

sentences.en: I have to tell you one, did I tell you this incident?
sentences.zh: 我得告诉你一个，我讲过这件事吗？

sentences.en: Because I really, it stayed with me all my life.
sentences.zh: 因为它真的让我终生难忘。

sentences.en: Just little things from her past that I had never known.
sentences.zh: 只是她过去的一些小事，我以前从未听说过。

sentences.en: My mother gave me money to buy a pint of sour cream.
sentences.zh: 我母亲给我钱去买一品脱酸奶油。

sentences.en: I didn't know how aware my grandmother was of the Great Depression when she was growing up.
sentences.zh: 我不知道我奶奶在成长过程中对大萧条有多少了解。

sentences.en: Because she was really young.
sentences.zh: 因为她当时真的很小。

sentences.en: She was like five, something like that.
sentences.zh: 她大概五岁左右，差不多那样。

sentences.en: On my way home, fooling around, the sour cream fell on the ground.
sentences.zh: 在回家的路上，我玩闹着，酸奶油掉在了地上。

sentences.en: Gone.
sentences.zh: 没了。

sentences.en: Shattered.
sentences.zh: 摔碎了。

sentences.en: Shattered, and there was no sour cream for dinner.
sentences.zh: 摔碎了，晚餐就没有酸奶油了。

sentences.en: That was it.
sentences.zh: 就是这样。

sentences.en: Didn't have the money to go back and get it.
sentences.zh: 没有钱回去再买一份了。

sentences.en: Now, it wasn't a tragedy, but I felt very guilty.
sentences.zh: 现在看来，这算不上什么悲剧，但我当时感到非常内疚。

sentences.en: I think talking to her about her past, making it through all of these different periods and challenges,
sentences.zh: 我想和她谈论她的过去，谈论她如何度过所有这些不同的时期和挑战，

sentences.en: makes me feel a little calmer, even though this is unprecedented, and we feel that.
sentences.zh: 让我感到平静了一些，尽管这是前所未有的，我们都能感觉到。

sentences.en: We feel how strange and new all of this is.
sentences.zh: 我们能感觉到这一切是多么陌生和新鲜。

sentences.en: It will become a story that we tell.
sentences.zh: 这终将成为我们讲述的故事。

sentences.en: Okay, Grandma, we're done for now.
sentences.zh: 好了，奶奶，我们现在做完了。

sentences.en: Okay, now you can take a risk.
sentences.zh: 好了，现在你可以冒险试一下了。

sentences.en: What's nice is that Ellie and I can just talk about things, which is lovely.
sentences.zh: 好的一点是，艾莉和我可以聊各种事情，这很棒。

sentences.en: You know, generation-wise, I think it's just marvelous that we've been able to connect and just talk to one another.
sentences.zh: 你知道，从代际角度来看，我觉得我们能够联结并互相交谈真是太奇妙了。

sentences.en: And there's nothing about, oh, I'm too old or she's too whatever.
sentences.zh: 而且没有什么“哦，我太老了”或者“她太怎么怎么样”的隔阂。

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: It's been a granddaughter and a grandmother, but a friendship of a different type, which has been very rich for me.
sentences.zh: 这是祖孙关系，但也是一种不同类型的友谊，对我来说非常丰富。

sentences.en: Okay, I'll call you when the 20 minutes is up and we can put the marshmallows in the...
sentences.zh: 好的，20分钟到了我会叫你，然后我们可以把棉花糖放进……

sentences.en: Yes, and then you'll make the balls.
sentences.zh: 是的，然后你就可以做圆子了。

sentences.en: We're returning to this place where the point of cooking is to feed ourselves.
sentences.zh: 我们回到了那个状态，做饭的意义是为了填饱肚子。

sentences.en: And in my case right now, it's to connect with my grandma.
sentences.zh: 而对我来说，现在是为了与奶奶联结。

sentences.en: So it's returning to that idea of connection and purpose.
sentences.zh: 所以这又回到了联结和目的的初衷。

sentences.en: So that's been something that I think I have realized and returned to as I hear her stories.
sentences.zh: 所以我想，当我听到她的故事时，我意识到并回归了这一点。

sentences.en: Love you, Grandma.
sentences.zh: 爱你，奶奶。

sentences.en: I love this whole thing.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这一切。

sentences.en: And everybody, stay well and be careful.
sentences.zh: 大家都要保重，小心行事。

sentences.en: I think you just have to hunker down and hope for the beSt.
sentences.zh: 我想你只能坚守阵地，祈求最好的结果。

sentences.en: I don't know that anyone can do anything.
sentences.zh: 我不知道还有谁能做什么。

sentences.en: Hope that the people that are dealing with the science and the medicine and so forth are going to get it done.
sentences.zh: 希望那些处理科学、医学等等事务的人能解决问题。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周的《Wirecutter秀》，我们正在为假期招待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们需要全黑的睡眠环境吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they black out to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是不是睡着了就断片了。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏或食物禁忌吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢喝咖啡还是茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用程序或你喜欢的任何播客平台搜索《Wirecutter秀》即可收听。
